finalText:
**Redis died and took prod down with it.**

```
02:14:07  redis refused connections at 10.0.0.12:6379
02:14:07  cache off, every read now hits the store
02:14:10  store overloaded, requests start timing out
02:29:12  queue passes its 500 limit, still climbing
02:31:44  worker-2 runs out of memory, restarts
02:31:52  api killed, service down
```

Redis never came back. All 13 reconnect tries were refused. Every error traces back to that one box. The outage ran 17 minutes 45 seconds. Fix Redis first.

The log is dated July 4, not last night.
